posts.title: Caverns of Shennog (Tales of Argosa)
posts.description: Today something different! Not a review but a note about a game i participated in. A while back I joined Eric's RPG Discord to participate in his "Once upon a game" series and managed to land a spot in a Tales of Argosa one-shot. The series is essentially a group of experienced players and GMs coming together to kick the tires on as many game-systems as possible and see what we can learn from them

posts.title: The Iron Coral (Into the Odd)
posts.description: I just concluded a play-by-post play-through of the The Iron Coral by Chris McDowall. We played the first floor in the second edition of the rules (the first edition entailed only this first floor) and kicked things off with the players in a boat towards the iron coral.
